programmes.funder: Corporación de Fomento de la Producción (CORFO), Chile
programmes.amount_note: Non-reimbursable co-financing of up to about 70% of project cost, historically capped around CLP 60,000,000, for startups that already have sales and need to scale.
programmes.deadline_note: Semilla Expande 2026 (nationwide) ran 15/01/2026-24/02/2026, results 15/05/2026; regional O'Higgins call ran 13/02-16/03/2026. All listed calls closed; next call not yet published.
programmes.reopen_note: Semilla Expande follows Semilla Inicia in CORFO's ladder and opens in annual convocatorias. Watch corfo.cl and the regional Comités de Desarrollo Productivo.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the company has sales and meets the revenue thresholds.
Apply during an open convocatoria on the CORFO platform.
Evaluation.
Award and milestone disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: Chilean companies with demonstrated sales below a defined ceiling; counterpart contribution required.

programmes.funder: Corporación de Fomento de la Producción (CORFO), Chile
programmes.amount_note: Non-reimbursable co-financing of up to 75% of total project cost, capped at CLP 15,000,000, to achieve technical and commercial validation of a prototype or fast-implementation idea. Some regional committees have run editions at up to CLP 17,000,000.
programmes.deadline_note: Run through regional Comités de Desarrollo Productivo Regional, so windows open region by region rather than nationally at once. Check corfo.cl for which regions are currently open.
programmes.reopen_note: Semilla Inicia opens in staggered regional convocatorias each year. If your region is closed, another region's window may still be open but you must be based there. The Chile Atiende record was last updated 30 June 2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Check corfo.cl for an open convocatoria in your region.
Prepare the project (technical and commercial validation plan) and the 25% counterpart.
Apply online through the CORFO platform in either of the two modalities.
Evaluation and award; funds disbursed against milestones.

eligibility.other_note: Open to natural persons and to companies that do not yet have sales; some editions cap company age at 18 months. Applicants must be based in the region running the convocatoria.

programmes.source_snippet: CORFO te cofinanciará con hasta el 75 % del costo total del proyecto, con un tope de $15.000.000

programmes.amount_note: CORFO allocates funds to accredited incubators and accelerators (SSAF operators), which then sub-allocate to startups. Amounts per startup have historically run to around CLP 60 million across SSAF-Semilla and SSAF-Desafío tracks.
programmes.deadline_note: Startups apply to the SSAF operator (incubator or accelerator), not to CORFO directly. Each operator runs its own intake calendar.
programmes.reopen_note: CORFO periodically re-tenders the SSAF operator concessions. Between operator calls, startups should approach currently accredited incubators listed on corfo.cl.

procedure_steps.detail: Identify an accredited SSAF operator (incubator or accelerator).
Apply to that operator's intake.
Operator selects and sub-allocates the CORFO subsidy.
Milestone-based disbursement with incubation support.

documents_required.doc: Chilean company RUT or commitment to incorporate

eligibility.other_note: Chilean-based ventures; foreign founders can qualify by incorporating in Chile.

programmes.name_en: Sercotec Seed Capital for New Businesses
programmes.amount_note: Competitive fund promoting the creation and formalisation of new businesses, historically awarding around CLP 3.5 million per beneficiary for investment and working capital plus technical assistance.
programmes.deadline_note: Regional convocatorias with defined windows announced on sercotec.cl.
programmes.reopen_note: Sercotec opens Capital Semilla Emprende convocatorias annually by region; the national announcement is usually made in the first half of the year.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Sercotec platform.
Apply during your region's open convocatoria.
Evaluation and ranking.
Award, then execute the investment plan with a Sercotec agent.

documents_required.doc: Proof of no formal business start or recent start depending on the edition

eligibility.other_note: Chilean residents starting a business; aimed at micro-enterprise formalisation rather than technology startups.

programmes.source_snippet: Otorga un subsidio de $3.500.000 para concretar las actividades detalladas en el plan de trabajo.

programmes.amount_note: Equity-free funding of CLP 15 million (about USD 15,000) for a four-month pre-acceleration programme, per the official Build page. Applications are not open now.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are not currently open; the official page says 'Stay tuned for the next application process'.
programmes.reopen_note: Start-Up Chile receives two Build generations of up to 50 startups each per year, so a new application window normally opens within a few months of a closure. Announcements are made on startupchile.org and corfo.cl; a past BIG cycle closed on 29 November with results in January.

procedure_steps.detail: Watch startupchile.org for the next generation window.
Submit the online application in English within the window.
Evaluation by external judges.
Selection, then relocate to Chile, incorporate or register locally and sign the CORFO contract.

eligibility.other_note: Open to founders of any nationality; the startup must be under three years old and founders must relocate to Chile for the programme duration. Equity-free.

programmes.source_snippet: Annually we receive 2 Build generations of up to 50 startups each

programmes.name_en: Crea y Valida (CORFO prototype-to-market innovation subsidy)
programmes.funder: Corporación de Fomento de la Producción (CORFO) - InnovaChile
programmes.amount_note: Individual projects up to CLP 180 million; collaborative projects up to CLP 220 million. CORFO co-finances up to 80% for micro and small companies, 60% for medium and 40% for large companies (so a micro or small company funds 20% itself).
programmes.deadline_note: Calls are opened by CORFO periodically; check the ChileAtiende fiche or corfo.cl for the current call window.

eligibility.other_note: Legal entities incorporated in Chile, paying first-category tax, with at least 3 years of existence. Micro and small = sales up to UF 25,000 a year; medium UF 25,000 to 100,000; large above UF 100,000. Women-led companies can get up to 10 points more co-financing under the focus-on-sustainability variant.

programmes.source_snippet: Si eres una persona jurídica constituida en Chile, tributas en primera categoría, con al menos 3 años de antigüedad, accede a un subsidio para el desarrollo de nuevos o mejorados productos (bienes o servicios), o procesos que requieran I+D ... Proyecto individual hasta $180 millones. Proyecto colaborativo hasta $220 millones. ... Micro y pequeña empresa hasta un 80%.

programmes.amount_note: Non-refundable subsidy of CLP 5,000,000 for business management actions and investments. The beneficiary adds a contribution set as a percentage of the subsidy in each call's bases.
programmes.deadline_note: The call listed on the programme page ran 27 August 2026 to 2 October 2026 12:00 and is now closed; Sercotec opens regional calls through the year.
programmes.reopen_note: Sercotec publishes new Crece calls on its open-applications page.

eligibility.other_note: Companies and cooperatives that started activities in the first tax category with annual net sales between 200 UF and 25,000 UF, with an economic activity matching each call's focus.

programmes.source_snippet: Entrega un subsidio de $5.000.000, no reembolsable, para financiar acciones de gestión empresarial e inversiones. ... ventas netas demostrables anuales mayores o iguales a 200 UF e inferiores o iguales a 25.000 UF ... Inicio: 27-08-2026 a las 12:00 hrs Cierre: 02-10-2026 a las 12:00 hrs

programmes.amount_note: Equity-free fund of CLP 75 million (approx. USD 100,000) plus the acceleration programme; founders must hold at least 10% of the shares.
programmes.deadline_note: Intake windows are announced on the Start-Up Chile site; check the page for the open call.

eligibility.other_note: Growth-stage startups. The page states the founder must keep at least a 10% shareholding; see the page for the remaining requirements. Foreign founders are accepted through the programme.

programmes.source_snippet: Equity-free funding … we'll give you a fund of 75 million Chilean pesos (Approx. 100K USD) equity-free. You must have at least a 10% shareholding the most...

programmes.name_local: FOGAPE — Fondo de Garantía para Pequeños Empresarios
programmes.name_en: FOGAPE state guarantee for small business loans
programmes.funder: Fondo de Garantía para Pequeños Empresarios (administered by BancoEstado)
programmes.amount_note: State guarantee covering up to 80% of a bank financing for clients with sales up to UF 25,000 and up to 50% for sales between UF 25,001 and UF 100,000; financing capped at up to UF 15,000 depending on beneficiary type. A guarantee commission is charged.
programmes.deadline_note: Standing guarantee used through participating banks; sales of the last 12 months must be accredited.

eligibility.other_note: Companies with annual sales not above UF 100,000, accredited for the last 12 months; the guarantee is requested through the lending bank.

programmes.source_snippet: Para empresas con ventas anuales no superiores a UF 100.000. Cobertura hasta el 80% del financiamiento, para clientes con ventas hasta UF 25.000. Cobertura hasta el 50% del financiamiento, para clientes con ventas entre UF 25.001 y UF 100.000. Tope financiamientos de hasta UF 15.000 según tipo de beneficiario.
